# Edge_Neuromorphic_Compute

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Deployment of neuromorphic processors at the network edge to perform real-time, event-driven computation on sensor data without cloud dependency. Supports TCC by distributing cognitive tasks across network nodes, reducing central bottleneck and enabling adaptive topology responses.
